description: This Java interface defines a contract for classes associated with resources, providing methods to retrieve resource path and type.

classes.name: WithResource
classes.description: An interface for entities associated with a resource, specifying methods to access resource path and type.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the path of the Resource represented by this entity.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the Resource represented by this entity.
